vendor_id: vendor_onfido
vendor_name: Onfido
vendor_type: identity_verification
retrieved_at: 2026-10-03

public_resources:
- https://documentation.onfido.com/identity-verification/identity-reports/liveness-report/
- https://onfido.com/resources/whitepapers/
- iBeta PAD Level 2 certification

key_components:

liveness_detection:
  active_liveness: Yes, challenge-response (blink, head turn, speak, follow object)
  passive_liveness: Yes, no user action required; analyzes texture, reflection, depth
  challenge_response: Unpredictable actions that static media cannot replicate
  3d_face_mapping: Reconstructs 3D face model from video to detect 2D presentations
  anti_spoofing_techniques:
    - Texture and lighting analysis
    - Motion analysis for natural vs scripted movements
    - Reflection and glare detection
    - AI/ML models trained on diverse spoof attempts
  anti_spoofing: iBeta PAD Level 2 certified
  detects: photos, masks, deepfakes, screen replays, printed images

document_verification:
  ocr: Yes, scans and reads text against templates
  template_compliance: Verifies document layout, hologram position, MRZ codes, fonts
  face_match: Compares document photo to real-time selfie/liveness
  advanced_forensics:
    - Microprint and security feature detection
    - Photo replacement detection (tampering at edges, shadows, color tones)
    - Compression artifacts and layering analysis
    - Barcode parsing and validation
  document_liveness: May require tilting or moving document; analyzes hologram interaction

device_and_session:
  integration: Web, mobile SDKs
  session_management: Standard verification session flow

fraud_controls:
  continuous_updates: Feedback loops from global network for model updates
  new_attack_vectors: Regular updates to address emerging spoofing techniques

compliance:
  certifications: iBeta PAD Level 2 (independent testing)
  tested_against: photos, masks, deepfakes, video replays, other spoofing attacks

notes:
- Strong emphasis on active challenge-response (harder to defeat than passive-only)
- 3D face mapping adds layer of depth detection
- Comprehensive anti-spoofing forensics on documents (microprint, security features)
- Document liveness (movement of document) adds temporal validation
- Does not disclose full-stack or code-level details but whitepapers available
